rationale: The reusable value is the portable skill/procedure pattern, not a mandatory upstream runtime.

FA3 already owns orchestration, MCP, authorization, evidence, security, memory and resource-governance boundaries; a parallel AI-Orchestra or execution-authority Skill Router would duplicate authority.
FA3 can implement the useful patterns natively and remain fully operational without cloning, installing, importing or contacting MengTo/Skills.
External skill content remains untrusted until admitted by the existing provider-neutral skill package admission contract.
